title: Policies, processes, procedures and practices for mapping, measuring and managing AI risk are in place and implemented
Accountability structures so the right teams are responsible for AI risk
Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility in AI risk decisions
Organisational culture that considers and communicates AI risk
Engagement with relevant AI actors and affected stakeholders
Policies for third party AI software, data and supply chain risk
Context of the AI system established and understood
AI capabilities, targeted usage, goals and expected benefits and costs understood
Risks and benefits mapped for all components including third party data and software
Impacts to individuals, groups, organisations and society characterised
Appropriate methods and metrics identified and applied
AI systems evaluated for trustworthy characteristics including validity, safety and security
Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time such as drift
Feedback about the efficacy of measurement gathered and assessed
AI risks prioritised, responded to and managed based on assessments
Strategies to maximise benefits and minimise negative impacts, including human oversight
AI risks and benefits from third party entities managed
Risk treatments including response, recovery and monitoring documented and reviewed
